tips.text: Hold Bone Skewer to throw the harpoon and pull an enemy to you. Tap it for a fast, short stab when they are already close.
Use Bone Skewer in melee range to fling the target behind you, toward your team.
Line up a clear path before you throw Bone Skewer, because the harpoon stops at the first unit it hits and a minion will take the pull.
Follow a Bone Skewer pull with Phantom Undertow while the enemy is slowed, so the stun lands and your team gets a free kill.
Dash with Phantom Undertow, because the stun comes from the phantom he leaves behind and returns. Aim so the phantom's path crosses the enemy.
Hurt enemies and break line of sight, then use Ghostwater Dive to hide. Gift of the Drowned Ones heals you only while enemies cannot see you.
Ghostwater Dive ends the moment you attack or cast. Use it to approach or flee, and enemies nearby are alerted to you.
Always have an escape plan. Pyke is fragile, and many of his attacking spells are also his ways out.
Use Death From Below on low-health enemies at level 6. It executes them, and you can recast it for free if a champion dies inside the X.

combos.name: Tap Bone Skewer
combos.when: Use it when an enemy is in melee range and you want fast damage and a slow, not a pull.
combos.text: Release Bone Skewer almost at once and Pyke stabs the closest enemy champion instead of throwing the harpoon. It is quicker, and you don't get locked in place.

combos.name: Flash during hook charge
combos.when: Use it when an enemy is just outside your hook range and expects you to be unable to reach them.
combos.text: Flash is allowed while Bone Skewer is charging, but not once the harpoon is in flight. Flash in the direction of the hook while charging to surprise them.

combos.name: Execute reset chain
combos.when: Use it in a teamfight when your first ultimate kills an enemy champion.
combos.text: Every kill inside the X lets you recast Death From Below for free within a short time. Look for a second low-health enemy to chain the execute.

tips.text: Hold Bone Skewer to pull Alistar out of position, then follow up with Phantom Undertow to stun him.
Stay out of Headbutt range; Alistar can dash to you and stun you. Keep minions in front of you.
Do not hook Alistar once he uses Unbreakable Will; back off and wait for it to end.
Target the enemy damage dealer instead of tough Alistar. Use Ghostwater Dive to slip away and regain health if you get hurt.

comboRefs.note: Tap Bone Skewer gives quick damage and a slow without a locked-in charge when Alistar is in melee range.

tips.text: Don't charge Bone Skewer in a straight line down the lane at Anivia. Flash Frost will hit you while you stand still.
Look for Phantom Undertow when Anivia has used Crystallize. Without her wall she can't block your dash.
Step out of Flash Frost's path. Its detonation stuns, and it is the way she sets up a kill on you.
Go for a Death From Below pick when Anivia is low. Her egg can come back, so kill her again or hit someone else.
Walk over Bard's Caretaker's Shrine to destroy it before his ally can take the heal.
Stay behind your minions or out of line with your ADC so Cosmic Binding cannot hit two targets or a wall and stun.
Hold Bone Skewer and pull Bard out of position. Do it away from his allies, since his Cosmic Binding stuns if you are in a bad spot.
Hold back Phantom Undertow until Bard has used Cosmic Binding. A stun on a fragile Bard usually wins the trade.
You can follow Bard through a Magical Journey portal if it looks safe, or flank him as he roams.
Do not commit to an execute while Bard has Tempered Fate up. It can freeze your target or you in stasis, so wait for it to be used.

comboRefs.note: Flash during the hook charge can surprise Bard, who has a slow bolt but no listed way to avoid the hook.

tips.text: Stay behind minions so Rocket Grab hits one of them instead of you.
Use Ghostwater Dive to break away after a trade; you heal damage you took while enemies can't see you.
Stay out of Blitzcrank's reach when Rocket Grab is ready. A pull into his Power Fist is a lot of damage on a fragile champion.
Use Phantom Undertow to stun Blitzcrank when he comes in close, then follow with Bone Skewer.
Hold Bone Skewer to pull Blitzcrank when he is out of position, then keep your distance. His shield only appears when he is low.

comboRefs.note: Tapping Bone Skewer stabs and slows at melee range without a long channel, handy when Blitzcrank is close.
Flashing during the hook charge can surprise Blitzcrank, who is just outside range and expects no hook.

tips.text: Hit Bone Skewer on Brand when he steps up to poke. He has no escape, so the pull leaves him easy to kill.
Brand needs to land one spell before Sear can stun, so dodge his first spell and his combo falls apart.
Use Ghostwater Dive to heal back the poke you took, then come back from a side angle.
Use Phantom Undertow when Brand is close; the stun gives your team time to kill him.
Do not stand next to your ADC or minions when Brand casts Pyroclasm. It is slow at first, so step away.

comboRefs.note: Flashing mid-charge lets Pyke's Bone Skewer reach Brand when he stands just outside hook range.
Tap Bone Skewer gives fast damage and a slow on Brand if he steps into melee range.

tips.text: Don't throw Bone Skewer into a raised Unbreakable, since it is destroyed on the shield. Wait for the shield to drop, or come at Braum from another side.
Once Braum has marked you with Concussive Blows, back out before you get hit again. The fourth stack stuns you.
Stay out of sight with Ghostwater Dive after a trade. Gift of the Drowned Ones heals back damage that champions dealt to you.
Don't stand in the slow zone Glacial Fissure leaves behind. Dodge the slam during its long cast time.
Hold Bone Skewer to pull Camille toward you. Her Hookshot can dash her away from the fight, so hit her when she cannot reach a wall.
Camille's Tactical Sweep slows and heals her, so avoid standing in its outer half.
Stun Camille with Phantom Undertow when she commits with Hookshot, then follow up with your damage.
Hide with Ghostwater Dive after a trade so you regenerate the damage she dealt.

comboRefs.note: Tap Bone Skewer gives quick damage and a slow when Camille is in melee range.

tips.text: Hook Janna with Bone Skewer when she steps up to poke; she is fragile and has few ways to escape once pulled.
Janna's Monsoon knocks you away and ends your all-in, so wait for it to be used before committing.
Land Phantom Undertow to stun Janna, then finish her before her Howling Gale can come out.
Hide with Ghostwater Dive after a trade so Gift of the Drowned Ones can heal the damage you took.
Hook with Bone Skewer only when you have a clear line to Karma. Her Inner Flame is a slowing poke that you must avoid.
Stay out of sight after a trade with Karma. Gift of the Drowned Ones then heals the damage she dealt.
Break the tether of Focused Resolve by moving out of range, or it roots you.
Use Phantom Undertow to stun Karma when she is without Mantra, because it makes her next ability stronger.

comboRefs.note: Tapping Q stabs a close Karma fast and slows her, so she can't easily kite you.
Flashing during hook charge can catch Karma outside your expected range before she reacts.

tips.text: Pull Leona toward you with a held Bone Skewer only when you can follow with Phantom Undertow; otherwise she gets a free fight.
Stay out of Zenith Blade range; if it hits you, she dashes in and Shield of Daybreak stuns you right after.
When Leona raises Eclipse, walk away for its duration before it blasts you.
Dodge out of the center of Solar Flare; only the center stuns, the edge only slows.
Break sight with Ghostwater Dive after a trade so Gift of the Drowned Ones heals you.

comboRefs.note: Tapping Q stabs at once with a slow and no root-in-place, useful when Leona closes in melee.
Flashing mid-charge can surprise Leona, who has no listed way to stop a hook from outside range.

tips.text: Hold Bone Skewer to pull Lulu to you, then stun her with Phantom Undertow; she is fragile.
Watch for Lulu's Whimsy before you dive; being polymorphed ends your engage. Wait until it is used.
Duck out of sight with Ghostwater Dive after trading so you regenerate, but expect Lulu's Help, Pix! to reveal you.
Stand behind minions when Lulu attacks, so Pix's bolts hit them instead of you.

comboRefs.note: Flashing during hook charge can reach a Lulu who stands just outside Bone Skewer's normal range.

tips.text: Hold Bone Skewer to pull Lux in when she steps forward; she is fragile and you can finish her fast.
Sidestep Light Binding; it stops at two enemies, so keep your minions or ally away from its line to avoid being rooted.
Stun Lux with Phantom Undertow once her Light Binding is used; she has few ways to get away.
Retreat with Ghostwater Dive when hurt to heal your recent damage, but stay out of Lucent Singularity, which reveals you.
Walk out of the red line before Final Spark fires; move to the side when low on health.
Hold Bone Skewer to pull Maokai out of position, then follow with Phantom Undertow to stun him. Do not stand in his Sapling Toss slow.
Check brush for saplings before you walk in or dive; they chase you and slow you down.
Maokai is untargetable during Twisted Advance, so do not waste Bone Skewer on him while he dashes. Keep Phantom Undertow ready to get away.
Use Ghostwater Dive to heal back damage after a trade. Hits on Maokai also speed up his Sap Magic heal, so poke sparingly.

comboRefs.note: Tapping Q gives quick damage and a slow without locking Pyke in place when Maokai closes in.

tips.text: Wait until Mel has used Rebuttal before you throw Bone Skewer or Phantom Undertow; her nova destroys enemy projectiles.
Hold Bone Skewer to pull Mel into your team when she steps up. Her Solar Snare is slow and easy to see coming, so stay out of its line.
Mel is fragile, so a landed Phantom Undertow stun gives you time to follow up and burst her.
Back off for a couple of seconds when Mel's hits pile up on you. Enough Overwhelm damage kills you outright.
When you are hurt, use Ghostwater Dive to hide and heal back damage Mel did to you.
Hold Bone Skewer to pull Milio away from his ally; alone he has few ways to get out of reach.
Look for Phantom Undertow when Milio stands still; the stun gives you time to follow up before he can use Warm Hugs.
Use Ghostwater Dive to heal back damage once Milio and his partner lose sight of you.
Use Death From Below on a low-health enemy. Milio's Breath of Life heals, so finish before he can cast it.
Stay out of the line of Ultra Mega Fire Kick, because its knockback and slow wreck your engage.

comboRefs.note: Flashing during the hook charge can catch Milio, who may think he is outside your hook range.

tips.text: Hold Bone Skewer to pull Morgana in, but only when no minion stands in the line; it stops at the first enemy and the pull is wasted.
Stay out of Dark Binding's line behind minions; if you are rooted, Morgana's team can punish you hard.
Wait for Morgana to use Black Shield before you dash in with Phantom Undertow; the stun will not work on a shielded target.
Use Ghostwater Dive to leave Tormented Shadow, then heal with Gift of the Drowned Ones once Morgana can't see you.
Don't stand in Tormented Shadow when low on health; it deals more damage to hurt targets.
Once Morgana has Soul Shackles, move away from her during the chains so you are not stunned.
Wait until Nami has used Aqua Prison before you go in. It has a long cooldown, and you are much safer without it.
Hold Bone Skewer to pull Nami to you when she steps forward to poke. Follow up with Phantom Undertow while she is slowed.
Step out of the way of Tidal Wave. It travels slowly, so you can see it coming and sidestep it.
Back off when the enemy ally has Tidecaller's Blessing. It is short-lived, so waiting it out costs you little.
If you take a hit, use Ghostwater Dive to hide. Gift of the Drowned Ones heals you back while enemies cannot see you.
Stay out of Dredge Line's path. Its anchor stops on the first enemy it hits, so keep a minion between you and Nautilus.
Pull Nautilus with Bone Skewer when he is exposed. He is tanky, so use it to set up your ally, not to burst him.
Do not run out of Riptide early. Wait until the waves finish or you take extra damage and get slowed.
Use Ghostwater Dive to escape and heal after a trade. Nautilus cannot easily find you once you are hidden.
Stun Nautilus with Phantom Undertow when he commits to an engage so you can get free damage on him.

comboRefs.note: Tapping Bone Skewer gives quick damage and a slow without locking Pyke in place against Nautilus.

tips.text: Hold Bone Skewer to pull Neeko out of her group, then stun her with Phantom Undertow, since she has little to escape with.
Stay out of Tangle-Barbs range and avoid standing behind minions, as the empowered tangle roots you much longer after hitting.
Watch for a disguised ally or minion that is Neeko; she can set up Pop Blossom unseen, so don't stack up on low-health allies.
Use Ghostwater Dive to get out of sight and recover health after a trade with Neeko.
Hold Bone Skewer to pull Pantheon in, and follow with Phantom Undertow to stun him.
Do not trade while Pantheon is bracing with Aegis Assault from the front. Step to the side or wait it out.
Stay away from Pantheon's range when you are low. Shield Vault stuns, and a thrown Comet Spear hits hard against low health.
Use Ghostwater Dive to disappear after a trade so you heal back damage. Pantheon cannot see you to follow.

comboRefs.note: Tap Bone Skewer stabs and slows Pantheon in melee range without locking Pyke in place.

tips.text: Hold Bone Skewer only when Poppy is not already near. A hit lets you pull her in, but a miss leaves you stuck and open.
Do not dash with Phantom Undertow while Steadfast Presence is active; Poppy stops the dash. Wait for it to end.
Stay away from walls behind you when Poppy is near. Heroic Charge into terrain stuns you.
Step on her buckler to deny her shield.
When Poppy starts spinning her hammer for Keeper's Verdict, move out of its line or get away. Don't stand still.
Hold Bone Skewer to pull Rakan away from his carry. He is easy to kill when alone.
Save Phantom Undertow to stun Rakan when he starts Grand Entrance. The stun knocks him down mid-dash.
Step out of line with minions when Rakan throws Gleaming Quill. It hits the first enemy in its path.
After a trade, hide with Ghostwater Dive to heal back the damage Rakan dealt.

comboRefs.note: Death From Below can execute a low-health Rakan, and a kill lets Pyke chain it onto another target.

tips.text: Hold Bone Skewer to pull Rell into your team. Land it before she gets close, because the tap version has very short range.
Her Shattering Strike stuns and destroys shields. Stay out of its range, and sidestep it when she winds up.
Use Ghostwater Dive to break sight and regain health, then come back with Phantom Undertow when Rell is out of position.
Do not stand clumped in Magnet Storm; she pulls everyone nearby to her. Dash out with Phantom Undertow if you are caught.
Hold Bone Skewer to pull Senna in when she stands within reach. Otherwise tap it to stab her at close range.
Stay out of Senna's Last Embrace line. It roots you after a short delay, so sidestep it or don't walk in a straight line toward her.
Use Ghostwater Dive to hide and regain health from Gift of the Drowned Ones after Senna pokes you down.
Land Phantom Undertow to stun Senna, then finish her with Death From Below; she is fragile.

comboRefs.note: Tap Bone Skewer stabs for quick damage and a slow without locking Pyke in place against Senna.

tips.text: Hold Bone Skewer to hook Seraphine when she steps forward. The pull drags her into your team and slows her.
Dodge High Note when you are hurt. It hits harder the less health you have.
Step out of the line of Beat Drop. If you are already slowed it roots you, and if you are stopped it stuns you.
Hide with Ghostwater Dive after a trade to heal back damage from Gift of the Drowned Ones. Seraphine's wide-area spells are poor at finding you there.
Hit Phantom Undertow on Seraphine to stun her. Do it before she can use Encore, since the charm and long range make it hard to dodge.

comboRefs.note: Tap Bone Skewer gives quick damage and a slow if Seraphine is in melee range, with no windup.
Flashing while charging Bone Skewer can catch Seraphine who thinks she is outside your hook range.

tips.text: Hit Shen with Bone Skewer's hold version when he walks up, to pull him out of position away from your carry.
Stay out of sight with Ghostwater Dive after a trade; you heal back damage taken from champions while hidden.
Don't swing at the target Shen is shielding with Spirit's Refuge; your basic attacks are blocked while it lasts.
Watch for Shen's Shadow Dash taunt before you engage; it forces you to attack him instead of your target.
Shen's Stand United can arrive from anywhere at level 6, so don't chase a low-health kill for long when Shen is gone from lane.
Hit Sona with Bone Skewer when she steps up to poke. Pulling her away from her minions and your enemies leaves her in trouble.
Stun Sona with Phantom Undertow, then follow up with Bone Skewer. She is fragile and cannot easily survive being caught.
Duck out of sight with Ghostwater Dive after taking poke. You heal back the damage while she can't see you.
Stay out of Crescendo's range when it is ready. Being stunned in the middle of her team usually means you die.
Sona's Song of Celerity speeds her away from you. Use Phantom Undertow to catch her, not Bone Skewer.

comboRefs.note: Sona is a ranged support, so a quick Bone Skewer stab gives fast damage and slow when she is in melee.
Flashing during Bone Skewer charge can reach Sona when she stands just outside your hook range.

tips.text: Hit Soraka with Bone Skewer when she steps up to cast. A pull into your team makes her an easy kill.
Stay out of Equinox. If you are caught in it you can't use abilities, then you are rooted when it ends.
Soraka's Equinox has a long cooldown. Go in with Phantom Undertow right after she uses it.
Step into the water with Ghostwater Dive after a trade so Soraka can't see you, and your Gift of the Drowned Ones will heal the damage back.
Go for Soraka with Death From Below if she is low. Her Astral Infusion costs her health, so she is easy to bring down.

comboRefs.note: Flash during hook charge can reach Soraka when she stands just outside normal hook range.

tips.text: Stay out of Nevermove's range, especially near minions. Rooted, you can be pulled in and killed.
Walk in close before Swain uses Death's Hand, because it hurts less from far away. Dodge sideways when he casts it.
Ghostwater Dive hides you and lets you heal back damage. Use it to get out of sight after a trade.
Move after casting Vision of Empire so you are not standing in it. Its long delay makes it easy to walk out of.
Do not hold Bone Skewer and charge it while Swain is close. A Nevermove root punishes you for standing still.
Aim Bone Skewer at Tahm Kench only when his Tongue Lash is down; otherwise stay out of its long reach.
Tahm Kench's Thick Skin shield soaks up your burst. Wait for him to use it before you commit your full combo.
When your health is low, go hidden with Ghostwater Dive and heal back damage with Gift of the Drowned Ones.
Avoid taking hits from Tahm Kench's basic attacks. Three stacks of An Acquired Taste let his Tongue Lash stun you.
Hold Bone Skewer to pull Taric or his carry out of position. Tap it if he is close, since the tap is faster.
Walk out of Dazzle or dash away with Phantom Undertow. It bursts after a delay, so move once you see it.
Do not go for an execute when Cosmic Radiance is coming down. Wait until it ends, then hit with Death From Below.
Punish Taric when he walks up to the minions to hit with Bravado. He is open to a pull then.
Use Ghostwater Dive to hide and regain health after a trade. His allies will see sharks if you are close.
Dodge Death Sentence by watching Thresh's cast begin, since it has a long cast time.
Hold Phantom Undertow until Thresh has used Flay or Death Sentence, then stun him and go in.
Break out of sight with Ghostwater Dive after a trade; Gift of the Drowned Ones heals you back when Thresh can't see you.
Hit Thresh with Bone Skewer at close range to throw him behind you, away from your carry.

comboRefs.note: Tap Q stabs instantly in melee, so Thresh's Flay-poking range can be answered without a slow charge.
Flash during Q charge can surprise Thresh, who may feel safe outside hook range.

tips.text: Stay out of Vel'Koz's Plasma Fission range. If it hits you, you are slowed and easy to follow up on.
Hit Vel'Koz with Bone Skewer when he steps forward. He has little mobility, so one pull can get you a kill.
Use Phantom Undertow to stun Vel'Koz as he starts Life Form Disintegration Ray; the stun interrupts it.
Use Ghostwater Dive to hide and heal back the damage Vel'Koz poked off you.

comboRefs.note: Flashing during the hook charge can close the gap on Vel'Koz, who tends to poke from long range.

tips.text: Hold Bone Skewer to hook Xerath when he is out of position. Pulling him toward you is the best way to get past his range.
Use Ghostwater Dive to close in and avoid his spells, then hook or stun him. He is weak up close.
Dodge Shocking Orb by stepping sideways. It is a thin line and a long stun is dangerous.
Attack Xerath while he charges Arcanopulse. He is slowed during the charge and cannot attack back.
When Xerath starts Rite of the Arcane, watch for his cast animation and dodge. Each shot lands after a short delay.
Pull back and hide after a trade. Gift of the Drowned Ones heals damage you took from champions while they cannot see you.
Don't waste Bone Skewer on Yuumi while she is attached; she can't be targeted. Aim at her ally instead.
Catch Yuumi when she is detached or dashing. Stun her with Phantom Undertow and she can't re-attach for a while.
Stay out of her Prowling Projectile. It slows and reveals you, so you can't heal with Gift of the Drowned Ones.
Aim your pull and stun at her ally. Once the ally is out of position, Yuumi's shield and heals matter less.
Stay out of Zilean's Time Bomb range. A second bomb on you sets off the first and stuns you right where Pyke wants you.
Hold Bone Skewer to pull Zilean in; he is fragile, so follow with Phantom Undertow to stun him.
Zilean can stop you getting away with Time Warp, so pick a fight with it on cooldown.
Do not use Death From Below on a target who has Chronoshift, because they will come back and you will be left exposed. Wait for the rune to fade or be used.
Break line of sight with Ghostwater Dive after a trade so Gift of the Drowned Ones heals you back up.
Pull Zyra with the hold version of Bone Skewer when she steps up to cast. It is your best way to get to her.
Step on Zyra's seeds before she grows them. Plants only appear when her spells hit a seed.
Her Grasping Roots is a long line. Walk out of its path or put minions in front of you, since it is blocked by them.
Use Ghostwater Dive to heal back the damage you took from her plants once you are out of sight.
Zyra is fragile. Stun her with Phantom Undertow and finish her off, and use Death From Below if she is low.
Move away from her plants. They die quickly, so back off for a moment instead of trading with them.
